Container.Name: roleplay-ollama
Container.Overview:
Ollama inference server — the model backend for Roleplay Server.
INSTALL THIS FIRST, then install the roleplay-server template and point it at this container.
REQUIRES the Nvidia Driver plugin (Apps tab), plus a reboot after installing it. After the container starts, pull a model from the Unraid terminal:
docker exec -it roleplay-ollama ollama pull HammerAI/smart-lemon-cookie
MythoMax L2 13B needs roughly 8-10 GB VRAM at Q4/Q5 quantization.

Config.Name: API Port
Config.Description: Ollama API port. The roleplay-server container connects here.

Config.Name: Models
Config.Description: Downloaded models. Several GB each — make sure this lives on a share with room.

Config.Name: NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES
Config.Description: 'all', or a specific GPU UUID from Settings > Nvidia Driver (e.g. GPU-4a1b2c3d-...).
